purpose: Inline status message with assertive role for surfacing time-sensitive feedback about a nearby action or region.
useWhen: Surfacing the result of a just-completed action such as a save failure or success.
Calling out a transient condition the user must notice immediately within a specific region.

avoidWhen.reason: Communicating a page- or app-wide notice that persists across views — use a banner instead.
Providing supplemental commentary or guidance inline with content — use a callout instead.
Wrapping a form control or an inline choice, such as a segmented-control — place it in the page flow with a plain label instead.
